    doctor         Check local runtime, backends, and optionally a GGUF model without inference

                   running server

    perplexity     Teacher-forced perplexity over a text file (llama.cpp llama-perplexity analogue;
                   CPU only). Reports mean NLL, perplexity, and position-bucket NLLs â the
                   TurboQuant/KVarN accuracy gate (issue #180).

    stt            Transcribe or translate speech audio into text and timestamps using native OpenAI
                   Whisper.
    embed          Generate dense semantic vector embeddings for text with pooling and Matryoshka

USAGE:
    opentail-llm-cli plan <OPTIONS>

    Read-only GGUF compatibility, hardware availability, and placement plan report

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                Prints help information
    -m, --model <PATH>        Path to a GGUF model file
    --profile <PATH>          Optional JSON planning profile; CLI values override profile,
                              environment, then defaults
    --save-profile <PATH>     Write the resolved strict planning profile; may be used without a
                              model
    --backend <NAME>          Backend preference: auto, cpu, cuda, or vulkan
    --device <NAME>           Requested device (none forces CPU; a named/indexed GPU is reported but
                              not selected by inspect)
    --target <NAME>           Eligibility target: cli (default) or server
    -g, --gpu-layers <N>      GPU layers: 0 = CPU, -1 = planner-selected, omitted = default 0
    -c, --ctx-size <N>        Context size (0 = planner/model default)
    --tq <BOOL>               Whether TurboQuant KV compression is requested
    --tq-mode <NAME>          TurboQuant mode: auto, kvarn, or lloydmax
    --kv-type <NAME>          KV element type: fp32, bf16, or q8_0
    --spec-type <NAME>        Speculation type: auto, none, or mtp
    --max-batch <N>           Requested maximum batch size
    --tool-grammar <BOOL>     Whether tool grammar is requested
    --no-gpu-probe            Do not initialize CUDA/Vulkan; report GPU availability as not probed
    --json                    Write machine-readable JSON to stdout
    --print-effective-config  Print the resolved planning configuration and exit; a model is not
                              required
    --print-profile-schema    Write the strict JSON Schema for --profile and exit; a model is not
                              required
    --explain                 Include the full selected/rejected decision trace in text output

USAGE:
    opentail-llm-cli perplexity <OPTIONS>

    Teacher-forced perplexity over a text file (llama.cpp llama-perplexity analogue; CPU only).
    Reports mean NLL, perplexity, and position-bucket NLLs â the TurboQuant/KVarN accuracy gate
    (issue #180).

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                               Prints help information
    -m, --model                              Path to GGUF model file
    -f, --file                               UTF-8 text file to evaluate (llama.cpp -f/--file).
                                             Tokenized raw (no chat template); the first -c tokens
                                             are scored.
    -c, --ctx-size                           Number of tokens to evaluate (default: 2048). Clamped
                                             to the model context length and the corpus length.
    --tq                                     Enable TurboQuant KV cache compression (same flag as
                                             the run command) (default: False)
    --tq-mode                                TurboQuant quantizer for --tq: auto (default: kvarn
                                             where supported, else lloydmax with a quality warning),
                                             kvarn (issue #180: 4-bit K / 2-bit V, 128-token tiles),
                                             or lloydmax (3-bit codebooks; severely degrades quality
                                             on QK-norm models such as Qwen3 — issue #432).
    --tq-window                              FP32 recent-token window before compression kicks in
                                             (default: 256; min 128 for kvarn — one full tile). Also
                                             sets the first position-bucket edge of the report, so
                                             pass the same value to the fp32 baseline for
                                             bucket-comparable numbers.
    --ngl, --n-gpu-layers, --gpu-layers, -g  Layers on GPU: 0 
[truncated]

    -p, --prompt                             Text prompt describing the image to generate
    --negative-prompt                        Negative prompt — what to avoid in the generated image
    --vae                                    Path to VAE safetensors file or directory
                                             (ae.safetensors or vae/ dir)
    --qwen-encoder                           (Z-Image) Path to Qwen3-4B GGUF text encoder (from
                                             Qwen/Qwen3-4B-GGUF)
    --qwen-tokenizer                         (Z-Image) Path to Qwen3 tokenizer.json
    --ngl, --n-gpu-layers, --gpu-layers, -g  (Z-Image) GPU acceleration: -1 = auto (CUDA→Vulkan→CPU,
                                             default), 0 = CPU only
    --device                                 (Z-Image) GPU to use: auto (default), none/cpu, an
                                             index (0, 1), or a named device (CUDA0, Vulkan1)
    --backend                                (Z-Image) Force compute backend: auto (default), cuda,
                                             vulkan, cpu
    --clip-l                                 (FLUX) Path to CLIP-L encoder safetensors
    --clip-tokenizer                         (FLUX) Path to CLIP tokenizer.json
    --t5xxl                                  (FLUX) Path to T5-XXL encoder safetensors
    --t5-tokenizer                           (FLUX) Path to T5 tokenizer.json
    -W, --width                              Output image width in pixels — must be divisible by 16

USAGE:
    opentail-llm-cli tts <OPTIONS>

    Synthesize high-quality speech audio from text using native Kokoro-82M TTS.

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                       Prints help information
    -t, -p, --text, --prompt <TEXT>  Input text to synthesize into speech audio.
    -e, --engine <ENGINE>            TTS architecture engine: kokoro (default), piper, f5tts,
                                     chatterbox, or melo.
    -v, --voice <VOICE>              Voice persona style preset (e.g. af_heart, af_bella,
                                     resemble_default, EN-US, EN-BR, ZH). Default: af_heart.
    -s, --speed <SPEED>              Speech generation speed multiplier. Default: 1.0.
    -o, --output <PATH>              Output destination path (.wav). Default: speech.wav.
    -m, --model <PATH>               Custom model checkpoint path (.gguf, .onnx, or .safetensors).
    --voices-dir <PATH>              Kokoro voice directory containing .bin / .gguf voice vectors.
    --ref-audio <PATH>               Reference audio path (.wav) for Zero-Shot Voice Cloning
                                     (F5-TTS).
    --ref-text <TEXT>                Reference audio transcript text for Zero-Shot Voice Cloning
                                     (F5-TTS).
    --vocab <PATH>                   Custom vocabulary / token file path (F5-TTS vocab.txt).
    --nfe <NFE>                      Number of Function Evaluations / ODE solver steps for
                                     Flow-Matching DiT (default: 32).
    --cfg <CFG>                      Classifier-Free Guidance strength for Flow-Matching DiT
                                     (default: 2.0).
